title: Making a plan
line: Look at the pawns, find a target, bring the pieces.

steps.text: With no tactic on the board, make a plan. First look at the pawns: which enemy pawn is weak, and which square can you use?
Find the target. Tap Black's backward pawn: one black pawn beside it is gone, and the other has moved past it.

wrong.d5: The black pawn beside and behind it guards that one.
wrong.a7: That pawn has no black pawn beside it at all. It is isolated, not backward.

steps.after: That is the target. No black pawn can guard it now, and it stands on a file your rooks can use.

steps.text: Now find a square for a piece. Tap the square in front of the target that no black pawn can attack now.
steps.hint: Black's pawns move down the board.
steps.after: A knight there would block the target, and no black pawn can attack that square now.

steps.text: Bring the pieces. Start the knight on its way to that square.
steps.hint: The knight goes through the edge of the board.
steps.after: Black puts a rook on the open file next to it.

steps.text: Put the knight on its square.
steps.after: Black's king steps toward the middle.

steps.text: Bring your other rook to the target's file.

also.b1c1: That puts a rook on the file too. This lesson keeps that rook on the open file beside it.

steps.after: The knight blocks the target and your rook stands on its file. Next, bring more pieces against it.

summary: Make a plan from the pawns: find the weak pawn, find a square for a piece, then bring the pieces one by one.
